BIS: Stablecoins and Bank Deposits Act as Substitutes as Deposit Hikes Slow Stablecoin Growth

BIS (Bank for International Settlements) working paper finds that stablecoins and bank deposits act as direct portfolio substitutes. Analyzing U.S. data, the authors show that a 1-basis-point hike in bank deposit rates cuts 10-week stablecoin market cap growth by roughly 3 percentage points (and up to ~9 percentage points under an IV approach). Cobo Wallet, One of the Early Crypto Wallet Apps Launched by F2Pool Co-Founder, to Shut Down

Digital asset custody provider Cobo announced that its Cobo Wallet App will shut down on December 1 as part of a strategic business adjustment. Users must withdraw all assets by November 30 at 11:59 PM (UTC+8). Any remaining assets will incur a monthly management fee of 2%, with a minimum charge of $100. Accounts holding less than $100 will have their entire remaining balance deducted. The first fee will be charged on January 1, 2027, and fees will continue until all assets are withdrawn or depleted.
